key_insight: ADP-HT routes LLM calls under a fixed budget by balancing predicted task success against conservative cost estimates to maximize tasks solved before service stops.
engineering_relevance: Budget-limited LLM services can use spending-aware routing and retry decisions to reduce the risk that costly responses leave later tasks unserved.
method: Learn task-specific success probabilities with a contextual bandit.
Estimate conservative costs from K-bit response-length labels across 2^K quantile intervals.
Adapt the cost penalty to realized spending and budget per remaining task.
evidence_signal: At the tightest tested budgets, ADP-HT solved over twice as many MATH500 and GPQA tasks as the best implemented baseline; it led mean cumulative scores at 10 of 14 RouterBench budgets and beat a commercial router’s default and cost-saving modes at the three lowest LiveCodeBench budgets.
watch_item: Cost-estimate guarantees require calibration, local regularity, and grid coverage; at fixed sample size, increasing K reduces discretization error but increases the estimation allowance.
paper_title: Pathwise-Budgeted LLM Routing: Online Allocation with K-Bit Tail-Cost Learning
